Photograph or image with embedded text
Mostly visual image with little or no text
Several content types with no clear primary subject

actions.label: Just the text
actions.instruction: Use the existing local OCR result in reading order. No cloud call.

actions.label: Paste clean formatting
actions.instruction: Transcribe the main content with its visible headings, paragraphs and lists. Remove application controls and duplicate interface chrome, not substantive content.

actions.label: Paste short handoff
actions.instruction: Produce a concise factual handoff of the visible exchange or work item. Include its subject, stated status and explicit next step where present. Do not explain the screenshot.

actions.label: Paste short summary
actions.instruction: Condense the visible source into a short ready-to-share factual passage. No introduction, interpretation, recommendations or explanation.

actions.label: Paste action items
actions.instruction: Extract only explicitly requested or assigned actions. Include owners and deadlines only when stated; do not infer commitments.

actions.label: Paste decisions and open questions
actions.instruction: Separate explicit decisions from explicitly unresolved questions. Do not infer agreement or generate new questions.

actions.label: Paste attributed quote
actions.instruction: Transcribe the main post or quoted passage exactly and append the visible author, handle and date where available. Do not invent attribution or a source URL.

actions.label: Copy visible links
actions.instruction: Extract only complete URLs visible in the screenshot, one per line. Do not reconstruct hidden hyperlink destinations.

actions.label: Paste review details
actions.instruction: Transcribe the review text with the visible author, rating, product and date, omitting absent fields.

actions.label: Paste stated positives and negatives
actions.instruction: Group only explicitly stated positive and negative points from the review. Preserve qualifications; do not add sentiment interpretation.

actions.label: Copy a value
actions.instruction: Return a JSON array of labelled exact visible values such as emails, phone numbers, URLs, dates and reference IDs. Preserve leading zeros. This output feeds a value picker; selecting a value pastes only that value.

actions.label: Paste key details
actions.instruction: Extract the main visible labelled fields as a concise field-value block, preserving field names, values and qualifiers. Do not add a narrative explanation.

actions.label: Paste checklist
actions.instruction: Convert explicitly stated requirements or tasks to unchecked checklist items. Preserve mandatory versus optional distinctions; do not add steps.

actions.label: Paste numbered steps
actions.instruction: Transcribe the visible procedural steps in source order as a numbered list. Do not supply missing steps or propose fixes.

actions.label: Paste ingredients
actions.instruction: Extract the stated ingredients with exact quantities and units. Do not scale quantities, substitute ingredients or infer amounts.

actions.label: Paste dates and submission details
actions.instruction: Extract visible deadlines, submission destinations, stated methods and reference links. Preserve dates and time zones without assuming a year or zone.

actions.label: Paste formatted clauses
actions.instruction: Transcribe the visible clauses with their numbering and headings. Do not interpret legal meaning or complete cropped clauses.

actions.label: Paste stated obligations
actions.instruction: Extract only explicitly stated obligations, responsible parties and deadlines. Preserve exceptions and conditions. No legal interpretation.

actions.label: Paste parties and dates
actions.instruction: Extract visible party names, roles and labelled dates. Do not infer missing parties, signatures or legal status.

actions.label: Paste contact block
actions.instruction: Extract visible name, role, organisation, email, phone, website and address into a clean contact block. Omit absent fields.

actions.label: Paste contact spreadsheet row
actions.instruction: Return a header and tab-separated contact row using only visible fields. Preserve phone numbers as text and do not infer contact details.

actions.label: Paste spreadsheet cells
actions.instruction: Reconstruct visible rows and columns as a rectangular tab-separated table with visible headers. Preserve values, units and blank cells; mark unreadable cells [unclear]. Do not calculate or execute formulas.

actions.label: Paste formatted table
actions.instruction: Reconstruct visible rows and columns as a readable Markdown table. Preserve headers, values, units and blanks; mark unreadable cells [unclear]. Do not calculate missing values.

actions.label: Paste CSV
actions.instruction: Return visible tabular data as RFC 4180-style CSV with a header when visible. Quote and escape cells appropriately. Preserve identifiers, units and blanks; do not calculate values.

actions.label: Paste JSON
actions.instruction: Represent visible labelled fields or records as valid JSON. Preserve exact source strings for identifiers and uncertain numeric representations. Omit absent fields; do not invent a schema beyond source structure.

actions.label: Paste itemised table
actions.instruction: Extract visible item descriptions, quantities, unit prices, discounts, taxes and line totals into a table, including only columns supported by the image. Do not recompute amounts.

actions.label: Paste expense details
actions.instruction: Extract visible merchant, transaction date, currency, tax, total and receipt reference as a compact expense record. Do not infer currency or calculate totals.

actions.label: Copy displayed total
actions.instruction: Extract the explicitly labelled final total with its displayed currency. If several candidate totals cannot be distinguished, return unavailable rather than choosing or calculating.

actions.label: Paste payment details
actions.instruction: Extract visible amount, currency, payment reference, due date, payment method and payee details as labelled fields. Do not infer payment instructions.

actions.label: Paste prices and billing periods
actions.instruction: Extract stated plan or product prices with their currencies, billing periods, conditions and discounts. Do not calculate effective prices or invent comparisons.

actions.label: Paste features by plan
actions.instruction: Group explicitly shown features and limits under the corresponding visible plan names. Preserve included, excluded and conditional indicators.

actions.label: Paste specification table
actions.instruction: Extract visible product or service specifications into a field-value table. Preserve model, variant, dimensions, units and qualifiers exactly.

actions.label: Paste status update
actions.instruction: Produce a short ready-to-send factual status using the visible subject/reference, status and timestamp. Include next steps only if explicitly stated. No promises or interpretation.

actions.label: Paste visible timeline
actions.instruction: List visible events with their displayed timestamps and statuses in source order. Do not fill gaps or invent intervening events.

actions.label: Paste event details
actions.instruction: Extract visible event title, date, time, time zone, venue, organiser and registration details into a compact block. Omit absent fields.

actions.label: Paste agenda or schedule
actions.instruction: Extract visible schedule entries with their stated dates, times, titles and participants. Preserve source order when dates or times are ambiguous.

actions.label: Paste journey or reservation details
actions.instruction: Extract visible traveller or reservation name, service, locations, dates, times, reference and status. Preserve time zones and local date labels; do not infer connections.

actions.label: Paste locations and stops
actions.instruction: Extract visible place names, addresses and explicitly ordered stops. Do not geocode, infer coordinates or add map links.

actions.label: Copy visible address
actions.instruction: Transcribe the explicitly visible postal or destination address. Do not infer an address from a map pin, person name or landmark.

actions.label: Paste student and result details
actions.instruction: Extract visible student identity, exam/course details and explicitly stated result. Do not interpret performance or calculate grades.

actions.label: Copy displayed result value
actions.instruction: Return labelled exact displayed totals, percentages and grades for a value picker. Do not calculate or predict any result.

actions.label: Paste form fields
actions.instruction: List visible form field labels, required/optional indicators, choices and written field instructions. Do not fill the form or invent answers.

actions.label: Paste labelled answers
actions.instruction: Extract visible entered answers with their field labels. Distinguish unanswered fields from explicit negative or zero answers.

actions.label: Paste code with indentation
actions.instruction: Extract only visible code, preserving indentation, comments and meaningful whitespace. Remove editor line-number gutters, not code. Do not fix, complete or execute it.

actions.label: Paste Markdown code block
actions.instruction: Extract visible code into a fenced code block, preserving indentation. Add a language label only when explicit or unambiguous. Do not fix or complete code.

actions.label: Paste code with file context
actions.instruction: Paste visible code together with displayed filename/path and relevant visible line references. Do not invent a repository, file path or missing lines.

actions.label: Paste commands only
actions.instruction: Extract literal visible commands, excluding shell prompts and command output. Preserve quoting and flags; do not generate or execute commands.

actions.label: Paste endpoint and method
actions.instruction: Extract the visible HTTP method, endpoint and shown query parameters exactly. Do not reconstruct hidden parameters or execute the request.

actions.label: Paste headers and request body
actions.instruction: Extract only displayed request headers and body, preserving names, values and structure. Do not infer authentication values or missing fields.

actions.label: Paste response payload
actions.instruction: Extract the visible API response body without interface chrome. Preserve literal values, nesting and types where legible. Do not repair missing data or complete cropped payloads.

actions.label: Paste visible diff
actions.instruction: Transcribe visible diff lines with addition/deletion markers and file context where shown. Do not infer changes outside the screenshot or review their quality.

actions.label: Paste visible change summary
actions.instruction: List only changes explicitly visible in the diff or release notes. Do not infer intent, runtime behaviour, impact or correctness.

actions.label: Paste review requests
actions.instruction: Extract explicit requests from visible review comments, with visible file/line context and author where available. Do not create new review advice.

actions.label: Copy error message
actions.instruction: Transcribe the exact visible error message and code, excluding unrelated interface chrome. Do not diagnose, explain or suggest a fix.

actions.label: Paste clean diagnostic log
actions.instruction: Transcribe visible diagnostic output or stack frames in order with timestamps, paths and line numbers intact. Remove only interface chrome. No diagnosis or invented log entries.

actions.label: Paste factual failure handoff
actions.instruction: Create a concise handoff with the visible failing operation, exact error, environment and displayed outcome. Include expected behaviour only if stated. Omit absent fields and do not infer cause, steps to reproduce or fixes.

actions.label: Paste expected versus actual
actions.instruction: Extract explicitly displayed expected and actual test results, preserving values and labels. Do not infer expected behaviour or calculate a difference.

actions.label: Paste displayed metrics
actions.instruction: Extract metric names, displayed values, units, periods and displayed comparison labels into a table. Do not calculate or interpret trends.

actions.label: Copy displayed metric
actions.instruction: Return labelled exact visible metric values with units and periods for a value picker. Do not estimate from chart geometry.

actions.label: Paste chart labels and period
actions.instruction: Extract visible chart title, axes, legend, units and time period. Do not describe what the trend means.

actions.label: Paste labelled data points
actions.instruction: Extract only numerically labelled or explicitly tabulated chart data into tab-separated cells. Do not estimate unlabelled points from pixels or infer missing periods.

actions.label: Paste chart reference
actions.instruction: Extract visible chart title, source, units and period as a compact reference block. Do not invent a source URL or interpret the graph.

actions.label: Paste settings and values
actions.instruction: Extract visible setting names and current displayed values or states. Do not infer hidden settings or recommend changes.

actions.label: Paste labelled process steps
actions.instruction: Transcribe visible process-node labels in an order explicitly established by arrows or numbering. Preserve branching labels. Do not invent an order where it is unclear.

actions.label: Paste labelled connections
actions.instruction: List visible source-node to destination-node connections with their displayed edge labels. Mark ambiguous direction rather than inferring it.

actions.label: Paste visible outline
actions.instruction: Reproduce only the hierarchy visibly established by headings, indentation, containment or connectors. Do not invent relationships.

actions.label: Paste text grouped by region
actions.instruction: Transcribe readable text grouped under existing window or region titles. If no title exists use neutral Region 1, Region 2 labels. Do not relate unrelated regions.

actions.label: Paste readable fragments
actions.instruction: Transcribe only clearly readable fragments, preserving separation and using [unclear] for unreadable gaps. Do not reconstruct missing words.

actions.label: Paste marked transcription
actions.instruction: Transcribe visible text in reading order and mark ambiguous or missing spans [unclear]. Do not guess, correct uncertain identifiers or provide explanation.

actions.label: Select a region
actions.instruction: Open a region selector for the existing screenshot and rerun extraction/classification on that region. This is an app control, not an AI prompt.

actions.label: Paste original image
actions.instruction: Paste the original captured image unchanged. This is an app control, not an AI prompt.

actions.label: Review extracted text
actions.instruction: Open the existing local OCR text for user editing before paste. Do not call an AI model.
